name: Polaris Office Corp.
summary: Polaris Office Corp. offers a variety of mobile-focused solutions and services. The company's operations are divided into two main areas: Office Software and Mobile Game. Within the Office Software division, it supplies the Polaris Office application, available for cloud environments, personal computers, and enterprise clients. Its Mobile Game division, on the other hand, specializes in both creating and distributing mobile games. Founded by Min-Cheol, Kwak on April 3, 1997, Polaris Office Corp. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
